user.title: Zero Home
user.description:
Link this Home Assistant to your Zero account. There is nothing to set here: what Zero may see and whether Home Assistant opens from outside are managed in your account on Zero's site.

How do you want to sign in?

menu_options.login: With my Zero username and password
menu_options.qr: With a QR code (approve it from my account)

reauth.title: Sign in to Zero again
reauth.description: This Home Assistant was signed out of your Zero account (from the account page, or the password changed). Sign in again to reconnect the home.

menu_options.login: With my Zero username and password
menu_options.qr: With a QR code (approve it from my account)

login.title: Sign in with your Zero account
login.description: Use the same username and password you sign in to Zero with. Your plan must include the smart home.

data_description.admin_api: Leave as it is unless Zero support told you otherwise.

qr_failed.title: Sign in with a QR code
qr_failed.description: Press Submit to show a new code.

progress.wait_qr:
Scan this code with your phone's camera and approve it in your Zero account — or open **{site}** and type the code.

![QR]({qr})

**{code}**

The code changes by itself every {minutes} minutes. This screen continues on its own once you approve.

error.plan: Your Zero subscription does not include the smart home. {server_message}
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Zero. Check the internet connection and try again.
error.bad_answer: Zero answered in an unexpected way. Try again later.
error.rejected: Zero did not accept the sign-in: {server_message}
error.need_2fa: This account uses two-step sign-in: sign in with a QR code instead.
error.denied: The sign-in was refused from the account.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Zero Home is already set up.
abort.already_configured: Zero Home is already set up.
abort.reauth_successful: Signed in again — the home reconnects in a few seconds.
abort.wrong_account: That is a different Zero account. Sign in with the account this home belongs to, or remove the integration and add it again.

ui_not_ready.title: Zero Home: the web interface from outside is closed
ui_not_ready.description:
Through Zero Home every visitor reaches Home Assistant as if they were at home, so the web interface from outside stays closed while Home Assistant gives home-network visitors extra rights ({blocker}).

To open it: turn off «Can only log in from the local network» for those users (Settings → People), or remove the «trusted networks» login. If your Home Assistant version still accepts it, adding these lines to `configuration.yaml` also works:

```yaml
{yaml}
```

Voice control and Zero's control of your devices work without it.

link_revoked.title: Zero Home: the home link was refused
link_revoked.description: Zero's relay keeps refusing this home's key. It retries by itself; if this stays, open your account on Zero's site → Smart home, or sign in again from Settings → Devices & services → Zero Home.

plan_ended.title: Zero Home: subscription does not include it
plan_ended.description: Your Zero subscription does not include the smart home, so the home link is stopped. Renew or upgrade it in your account on Zero's site; the integration reconnects by itself.

relay_unreachable.title: Zero Home: cannot reach the Zero relay
relay_unreachable.description: This Home Assistant has not been able to reach the Zero relay for more than 30 minutes (last error: {error}). Check the internet connection; the integration keeps retrying on its own.

external_url_conflict.title: Zero Home: external URL already set
external_url_conflict.description: Home Assistant's external URL is {current}, so Zero Home did not change it to {public_url}. To use the Zero Home address in the mobile apps, open the Zero Home options and confirm the replacement.

signed_out.title: Zero Home: signed out of the Zero account
signed_out.description: This Home Assistant was signed out of your Zero account (from the account page, or the password changed), so the home link is stopped. Open Settings → Devices & services → Zero Home and sign in again.

home_method_external.title: Zero Home: your account uses its own address
home_method_external.description:
Your Zero account links Home Assistant with its own external address, so the Zero Home link is not used. To use Zero Home instead, switch the linking method in your account: {manage_url}

This clears by itself once you switch.

home_home_disabled.title: Zero Home is switched off in your account
home_home_disabled.description:
Zero Home is switched off in your Zero account, so this home is not linked. Switch it on here: {manage_url}

The link starts by itself within a minute.

home_not_chosen.title: Zero Home: choose how to link the home
home_not_chosen.description:
Your Zero account has not chosen how to link Home Assistant yet. Choose «Zero Home» here: {manage_url}

The link starts by itself within a minute.

home_plan.title: Zero Home: subscription does not include it
home_plan.description:
Your Zero subscription does not include the smart home. Renew or upgrade it here: {manage_url}

The link starts by itself once it does.
